notice: Single source the release-1.0 gate reads (scripts/release-readiness.mjs). Decisions carry recommended values but stay red until a human sets status to approved with decidedBy/decidedAt. Derived gates re-evaluate from committed evidence on every run; operator gates require an attestation file whose statements are all literally true. The 1.0 policy widening wires the --check mode into the release workflow; until then this manifest is advisory and test-pinned.

stableApiClaim.note: 1.0 promises the enumerated compatibility surfaces, not a blanket stable API; stablePublicApi stays false and npm publication stays disabled.

reportRevisionR3.note: Deciding r3 also decides the public ServiceRole field and is the only lawful vehicle for erratum E2; r1/r2 stay byte-immutable either way.

calibrationCensoringPolicy.note: The zero-censoring eligibility rule is near-unsatisfiable on the open web (pilot: 37.5% capture failure); declare the policy before paying labelers.

decisions-approved.title: Every release decision is approved by a named human

compatibility-surface-pinned.title: The compatibility promise exists and matches its pinned digest

errata-resolution.title: No erratum is left without a decided vehicle

current-method-corpus.title: A current-method cohort clears every claim-bearing metric denominator

aa-repeatability.title: A preregistered A/A study passes its declared thresholds

detector-calibration.title: Every claim-bearing detector has an eligible study at the current identity

legal-review.title: Every runtime third-party item has a completed review

runner-cycles.title: At least two controlled-runner cycles carry verifying destruction receipts

r2-lifecycle.title: A fresh lifecycle readback receipt shows one healthy reports/ backstop

release-receipt-archive.title: The durable release-receipt archive lane is proven with at least one archived receipt

durable-soak.title: Durable jobs completed the declared soak with a real restart in the window

egress-backstop.title: An independent network egress boundary exists and was tested with the app guard treated as failed

waf-ceilings.title: Both WAF admission-route ceilings re-proven for this candidate

log-retention.title: Bounded, redacted log-retention query re-captured for this candidate

staging-teardown.title: Staging resources torn down with same-session absence proofs for BOTH staging buckets

container-image-licensing.title: The container base image's shipped packages have a completed license review
